# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Both are capped at 40 because a blocker applies: robots.txt blocks Googlebot from the whole site (`static/robots.txt:5`). Nothing was left unknown, so the score is a single number read from code. The two main problems are that Google is told to stay out entirely and that every page is built in the browser, so crawlers get an empty page. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Google's crawler is told not to visit any page, so the site can't be found through Google search. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 72/100, Good. The cap is lifted and GEO-009 and GEO-014 both become Clear. ### 2. Render pages on the server - **Why it matters:** `ssr = false` means crawlers get an empty shell. The headings, text and links appear only after JavaScript runs. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small (delete the line, or set it to `true`) - **Score after this:** 3 more points (GEO-003 becomes Clear). On its own it gives 60. Combined with item 1 it gives 84. ### 3. Add `lang` to `` and fill in missing descriptions - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells tools what language the site is in. The `/shop` description is empty, so that page has no summary. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 2 more points (GEO-012 becomes Clear). With items 1 and 2 together it reaches 86. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | `static/robots.txt`, plain text with valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers can get in | Problem | `static/robots.txt:5`, Googlebot `Disallow: /`. I assumed you want to be found, since there is no config. | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | `static/robots.txt:5` blocks Googlebot on `/` and `/shop`. `/search` is deliberately noindex and is left out. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on your domain | Clear | `/` and `/shop` both set an absolute `https://quay.example/...` canonical | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, site-wide | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`. The Product has only `name`, with no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | `static/sitemap.xml` and the `Sitemap:` line at `robots.txt:7` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang`. `/shop` has an empty description. | | GEO-016 | Key routes are linked | Clear | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5`, plain `` links | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict | Clear | Only a scoped `data-nosnippet`, which is a deliberate choice | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | I read the layout and the three pages. There are no images or unlabelled controls, and every page has a title. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not present, and not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not applicable | Not scored | ## Other problems found - **Sitemap and robots.txt contradict each other:** `static/sitemap.xml:4` lists `https://quay.example/shop`, but `static/robots.txt:5` (`Disallow: /`) blocks Googlebot from it. Removing the Googlebot block fixes this. ## Worth considering - **Product details:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9`: `

Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.

`. The page names its products but gives no details. Giving each product its own page with price and description would give people and machines something concrete to read, and each page could carry complete Product data. - **Shipping claim:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7`: `

Marine parts, shipped next day

`. The only delivery detail is in a `data-nosnippet` block, and the cutoff time and regions appear nowhere. A short shipping section in the page text would back up the claim. - **Search page has no description:** `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:2-3`. This is low priority because the page is deliberately noindex. It would only matter if you later remove the noindex. - **Site identity:** there is no Organization or WebSite structured data in `src/routes/+layout.svelte`. Adding the store name and URL, which the site already shows, would label who runs it. - **Head basics:** `src/app.html:3-6` has `charset` but no `viewport`, and there are no social tags (`og:title`, `og:description`) on any page. Both could be added in the shared head. - **Page structure:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:6` has no `
` around the page content, so adding one marks the main content for readers and tools. - **Sitemap dates:** `static/sitemap.xml:3-4` has no ``. Adding dates would help crawlers if you have real update dates. - **Hand-kept sitemap:** `static/sitemap.xml` is a static file. Once you add product pages, generating it from the routes would keep it in step. - **Shop description:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` has `content=""`. Something like "Bilge pumps, cleats and rope for boats" might help summarise the page. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status of URLs:** a live scan would show whether `quay.example` URLs answer 200 and whether the server adds headers such as `X-Robots-Tag`. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site, because there is no `geo.config.json`. - `https://quay.example` is your real domain. It is the same in the canonicals, the sitemap and robots.txt. - `/search` is deliberately noindex and kept out of the sitemap. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
